spans.title: The Dream in the Marble Room
spans.blurb: In a dream she wears another woman's jewels and waits, half in terror, for a turbaned stranger whose gift carries a serpent's fascination.

spans.title: The Princess and the Genie
spans.blurb: With the boarding house empty for one afternoon, a lonely lodger and a slangy errand boy transform the dreary parlor into an enchanted palace.

spans.title: Open and Shut
spans.blurb: A man lies shot dead in the road, his killer found sprawled senseless beside the rifle. The sheriff waits alone with the evidence while a mob gathers outside.

spans.title: A Pint of Water
spans.blurb: Left behind on a desert march, a fainting traveler begs the passing thousands for water and is mocked, until one young stranger stops beside him.

spans.title: The Dropped Match
spans.blurb: Sleepless past midnight, Margot drops a burning match beside her bed and leans over to find it. Something in the dark finds it first.

spans.title: Her Uncle's House
spans.blurb: Off the night train from the farm, Ellen follows her suave uncle into a big echoing house where lights burn low and the housekeeper hints at secrets.

spans.title: When the Clock Struck Twelve
spans.blurb: The old house is deadly still until the clock strikes twelve, and then come clanking chains, breaking crockery, and a screech no honest thing could make.
spans.brokenNote: Cuts off mid-sentence just as the narrator steps into the hall, before the noises are faced or explained.

spans.title: The Spider's Thread
spans.blurb: From the lotus pond of Paradise, the Buddha looks straight down into Hell and remembers the one good deed of a robber squirming below.

spans.title: The Devil's Flowers
spans.blurb: A friendly foreign priest tends a field of nameless purple flowers and offers a passing cattle dealer a simple wager: guess what they are.

spans.title: The Great Flea Campaign
spans.blurb: Plagued by fleas in a Soho lodging, a man of odd practicality goes to war armed with treacle, newspaper, and a flash of genius.

spans.title: The Man with Beautiful Hands
spans.blurb: A car lies wrecked in the night. Its passenger steps out, checks each finger of his exquisite hands, and only then glances at his bleeding chauffeur.

spans.title: The New Year's Kiss
spans.blurb: A hurt boy lies in a hospital bed on New Year's morning, and a motherly nurse's small kindness undoes him completely.
